title: Launcher Orient Kit: compact onboarding mosaic & tour assets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a compact 'Launcher Orient Kit' asset bundle for the console first-run experience. Focus on a mosaic-style checklist card, progressive tips panel, three empty-state variants (no-projects, expired-credit, no-models), and localized screenshot templates for docs and release notes. Deliverables: Figma frames (responsive 1280/1024/480), export slices (SVG/PNG/AVIF), copy variants (short/concise and explanatory), and a lightweight animation spec for the tour step transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file uploaded to 'Drive:Design/Console/OrienterKit/2026-03' with version notes
Exported assets in PNG/SVG/AVIF at 1x and 2x, named with release tag
3 empty-state templates implemented: no-projects, quota-expired, no-models
Accessible color contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for primary CTA text
Preview screenshots added to docs PR and one-stage A/B test config created
